messages.subject: Thanks for emailing the Peckham Liberal Club Re: Jake Essex for Peckham Liberal Club?
messages.body:
Hi there,

Thanks for getting in touch

If you are interested in being a member of the club the best thing to do is head down to us at 24 Elm Grove, Peckham, and buzz the door. Ask to come and have a look at the club, and say you are interested in becoming a member. Charles Coote is the president and he will give you an application form. Membership costs £20 a year and you need the signatures of two existing members.

If you are enquiring about booking the club for an event then please contact our events manager Janice Brittain in the first instance - you can reach her at the club on 020 7639 1093 or 07527 912 119 (not on Tuesdays). this is the best way to book or check availability

More information on our venue is available here: http://www.peckhamliberalclub.org/venue-hire

Web and Social Media manager
